title: Microsoft IQ

signIn.hint: The business plugin page is a Power BI frame inside the portal; it can ask for the account again. "Plugins could not be loaded" in the add picker: press Retry.

endorsement-menu.note: The endorsement menu is placed by script under its badge. A demo gives the frame: { use: 'endorsement-menu', frame: 'f4' }.

side-pane.note: The navigation: 200–480 px, live. A demo gives the frame: { use: 'side-pane', app, frame }.

fallbacks: No dark theme: Microsoft IQ renders light whatever the OS is set to
Power BI visuals are drawn in canvas and SVG with literal colors

writes.what: Adds an item (a plugin, a document) to a section of the business plugin; the landing's "N curated here" goes up by one

undo.note: The UI path to remove an item isn't recorded yet; a private pack adds the API undo, run in the capture browser's signed-in session.

check.expect: The item isn't in its section, and the landing shows the count the demo starts with.

writes.what: The endorsement badge › Certified (or Promoted) endorses the business plugin

undo.note: A private pack can add the API undo.

effects.what: The landing's "N curated here" counts the items in every section

check.expect: The count the demo starts with.

effects.what: The business plugin can be renamed by its owners between runs (the page title and the add picker follow)

check.expect: The page title is the name the demo expects; if not, the demo's names need updating.

notes: The portal is a shell around Power BI frames: hovers and clicks failed in the extension frame (frames.skip), zoom captured 9 levels in 13.9 s. On All, searching the add picker doesn't list plugins; the Plugins tab does. The review dialog's summary and when-to-use boxes start empty. Pre-release hosts (the daily ring) and the API undo live only in a private pack.
